Lamborghini Teases New Supercar Ahead of Next Week’s Debut, It’s Likely the Temerario Spyder
6 photos
Photo: Lamborghini
Lamborghini has a strange way of teasing new products . While other companies tend to fill their social media pages with all kinds of posts announcing the upcoming model, the Raging Bull shared a single picture of it on its official website.
If you head over to that website, then you will see a blue-finished machine in the header, accompanied by a few words: “Save the date” and “November 18th, 8PM, Los Angeles.” This is when the vehicle will be shown to the world, and it will likely celebrate its public debut at the 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show.
But what exactly are we looking at? Well, given that the Revuelto family has been expanded to include the new SuperVeloce , a more track-focused product with extra oomph and numerous other upgrades compared to the regular supercar, and that the Urus lineup is entirely fresh and comprises a single model, the SE Performante, the only ride still in the making at the Raging Bull is the open-top version of the Lamborghini Temerario.
The model will be known as the Lamborghini Temerario Spyder, and we’ve seen it on a few occasions. It made its track debut in front of the camera more than half a year ago, and a couple of months later, we got the chance to see it testing on video. Subsequently, the open-top model has been rendered several times, and the pixel-altering crowd has given us a great preview, with the CGIs offering a good look into the design from multiple angles.
Photo: Baldauf Given that it is the convertible version of the Lamborghini Temerario , we already know many things about it. The styling is definitely no surprise, as it will look just like its fixed-roof sibling, save for open-top view of the sky above. The folding roof is stowed in a special compartment behind the seats, and it is likely electrically operable. The rumor mill says that it takes about 17 seconds to lower and raise, though we’d take this number with the proverbial pinch of salt for now for obvious reasons.
Due to the reinforced body, a mandatory measure to help the supercar corner properly, we expect the Lamborghini Temerario Spyder to be a bit heavier than the Coupe. The latter has a dry weight of 3,726 pounds (1,690 kg), and it is 185.3 inches (4,706 mm) long, 78.6 inches (1,996 mm) wide, and 47.3 inches (1,201 mm) tall, with 104.6 inches (2,658 mm) between the axles. It’s likely that the Spyder will have an identical footprint, though we wouldn’t be surprised to learn that the height might be different.
Beneath the skin , it will probably have some suspension tweaks. Nothing too major, obviously. As for the firepower, it will continue to be supplied by the assembly that powers the Lamborghini Temerario Coupe. This means three electric motors assisting the twin-turbocharged V8 engine, which develops 907 horsepower (677 kW/920 ps) in total. The fixed-roof model has a 213 mph (343 kph) top speed, and takes just 2.7 seconds to hit 62 mph (100 kph) from naught.
Photo: Baldauf As a result, it is only two-tenths of a second slower from 0-62 mph than the larger, more powerful, and much more expensive Revuelto, and three-tenths of a second slower than the Revuelto SV. Chances are that the Lamborghini Temerario Spyder could complete the sprint either in 2.7 or perhaps 2.8 seconds due to the added weight, and while we do not know it yet, we believe that the top speed will be a tiny bit lower.
The exotic hair blower on wheels is, as we told you above, just a few days away from being presented to the world, so we will definitely save the date, as we want to know everything about it. Thus, expect all kinds of comparisons with its fixed-roof sibling, as well as some of its biggest rivals in the class. Shortly after the presentation, we reckon wheelmakers will render it on their alloys, and the pixel-altering crowd will also drop several CGIs, showcasing it in different configurations, as well as some virtually tuned ones.
Mind you, the Temerario Spyder is not the only supercar in the making at Lamborghini, because we recently saw a very mysterious Revuelto with its body wrapped in camouflage being driven in the open. It looks more aggressive than the standard supercar, as well as the SuperVeloce, and due to this, some say it might be the SVJ (Super Veloce Jota). Guess we will have to wait to find out if that is indeed the case, but it’s definitely something else to look forward to when it comes to the Raging Bull.
Before wrapping it up, we have to remind you that the Lamborghini Temerario Spyder is not the only convertible in the company’s modern-day lineup, because the automaker also offers the much rarer Fenomeno Roadster , which was officially presented some six months ago.

This Travel Trailer Is Built in Traditional Teardrop Fashion and Invites Couples To Call It Home
9 photos
Photo: Caravancol
The urge to just leave your landlocked lifestyle behind is one that often drives many of us to set their sights on a travel trailer, and one of the most called upon designs of all time is the teardrop camper.
Teardrop campers are considered one of the most affordable and accessible camping options the world has ever produced, and over the years, the rather simple design has been subject to countless variations, with nation after nation taking a crack at it.
One of the most important takeaways of a teardrop camper is that they’re designed to be light and as economical as possible, placing as little stress on your vehicle as the design will allow. This places it on the radar of countless vehicle owners; even some motorcycles can tow a teardrop camper.
Photo: Caravancol The main material that sits at the core of a traditional teardrop has always been wood. Sure, on top of it all, fiberglass skins are often added, but the base has often to always been wood. Even these days, manufacturers and brands still call upon this primordial and renewable resource as the base layer, so to speak, of their teardrop campers.
Since humans have been tampering with the teardrop for ages, we’ve gotten pretty good at building them and helping them push the limits as to how far they go. In time, we developed methods to build teardrop campers entirely out of composite materials, and the benefits, as you can expect, are paramount.
Composite monocoque or one-piece campers are among some of the most resilient around, and if taken care of, they can last for downright decades. Some of the wildest spins on this timeless camper style are found in Australia and the US.
But, there are countless other countries that have taken a crack at the teardrop camper, and one of them is Spain. Yes, Spain, the European country has been causing quite the stir in recent years, with campers that not only tap into traditional building materials to give it that unique touch these RVs are known for, but to actually come across with vintage styling.
Photo: Caravancol One brand I recently stumbled across is none other than Caravancol, a team on which we shed some light before, but who deserves to be in the spotlight even further. You may remember their Classic trailer, with its rather bulbous front end and classic styling that very few teardrop campers offer these days.
It’s those kitchen side skirts that give off this impression, and for the Wild, the unit in question today, also brings forth this unique trait. Take a moment to picture yourself at the galley of this camper, whipping up a meal and desert, with the wind being kept at bay, and the rain too. And, to access this styling , you don’t have to do anything; just lift the hatch.
The Wild also gets its name from the fact that it’s ready to tame some wilder terrain, and is rocking running gear that’s a step up than what the Classic offers. A reinforced Al-Ko axle with shock absorbers is used here, along with an inertia brake and 205/80 rubbers on 16-inch alloy rims.
But, GVWR is still limited to 750 kg (1,653 lbs), just like the Classic, and the reason being that you won’t need any special driver’s license class to operate this one. The Wild does weigh 550 kg dry, so a lightweight camper indeed.
Photo: Caravancol While wood is used as the primary building block for this camper and its shell, it can take quite the amount of load and can be seen with that roof-rack cage lining the outer edge, perfect for adding an awning, outdoor shower, annex, and more. Some images also showcase a couple of solar panels on top, the way to go for true off-grid living.
Another material that also makes its appearance in the Wild is aluminum. This is yet another called upon material in the industry and is often used on the exterior of a camper, as is the case here, helping seal off the underlying wooden structure and protecting it from the elements. It’s a pretty standard procedure; a layer of lacquer is added to help water roll off the walls.
Keep in mind that everything I just mentioned is included in the standard features list, and options, while there are a few, won’t really need to be tapped into. But, it does depend on where you’re traveling and what time of year.
Photo: Caravancol Inside the Wild, what I found rather interesting is that Caravancol aimed to create a space that’s as modular as possible, allowing us to craft a social space or use it as a bedroom. The neat side is that in its social layout, the Wild places opposing seating at our fingertips, so you can easily communicate with guests if you have any.
As far as pricing goes, the Wild is going for €19,490, the equivalent to around $21,600, placing it within the same price range that we would see in an American teardrop camper of the same style and makeup.
Is Spain the last frontier in terms of traditional teardrop campers? Probably not, but we can see that this country means business and knows how to craft a camper worth considering; if you live in Europe, that is.
If you’re in North America, there’s really no shortage of brands to choose from, and frankly, within the same price range.

EICMA 2026 • Triumph TF-E Bikes Get Even More Enduro With Updates for the 2027 Model Year
Android Auto 18.2 Shows Up Online for the First Time, Here's How To Download It
6 photos
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution/Google
A new update, a new session of the Russian roulette. A new Android Auto update is now preparing to roll out to all Android devices out there, with the very first beta showing up online today. The download links are already live, so if you want to give a try to this update, you can manually install it even if you’re not part of the beta program.
Installing the latest Android Auto update on day one - and sometimes, even at a later time - has so far proved to be quite a risky game. These new releases often introduce new bugs - such as this glitch that breaks down notifications - and Google is rarely in a rush to release patches.
Meanwhile, Android Auto 18.2 has now started the public testing stage, with the production rollout expected to begin as early as next week if - and this is quite a big if - no major bug is found. I already installed this build on my Google Pixel 10 Pro XL , and everything seems to be running just fine, though I have to say that my experience with Android Auto hasn’t been as buggy as in the case of other users.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution How to download Android Auto 18.2 The first thing you must remember is that this fresh build is specifically aimed at users who are enrolled in the Android Auto beta program.
All seats have been reserved for quite some time, so if you want to download this build outside the beta program, you need to use the stand-alone APK installer. The file is available as a separate installer on this page .
The manual update process is fast and simple, and you just need to download the file and save it on your Android smartphone. Navigate to its location, tap it to initiate the update, and follow the on-screen wizard to complete the update. There are no difficult steps, and in some cases, depending on the configuration of your device, you might be prompted to enable special permissions, such as allowing the installation of apps from outside the Google Play Store.
When you’re done, on the settings screen, the Android Auto version should be 18.2 (beta for now).
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution What’s new and what to expect While Google no longer offers changelogs for the new Android Auto builds it releases, we already know that several big things are coming. A major update has been in the works for quite some time, and every new release, such as this 18.2 beta build, brings us closer to its debut.
Android Auto will get support for widgets - such as weather and calendar - to show the essential data directly on the home screen, without needing to launch the stand-alone apps.
The widget support will land alongside support for video apps . YouTube will pioneer this feature, allowing users to watch videos in their cars without touching their phones. YouTube will only work when vehicles are stationary, and once you start driving, the app can switch to an audio-only mode if you own a Premium subscription.
Background audio is not part of the free tier, and considering this feature blocks the video playback and retains only the audio track of a video, you need YouTube Premium.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution Meanwhile, Google is introducing a new feature for Google Pixel owners.
The company confirmed in the November Pixel Drop - the most recent Google Pixel update rolling out in November 2026 to all Google phone models still getting updates - that proactive suggestions are rolling out via Gemini Intelligence.
This means that Gemini will connect to other Google services on your Google Pixel, such as Gmail, to look for information relevant to what’s happening on the screen. For example, if someone sends you a message to ask about your next flight, Gemini can quickly look into your inbox for flight information, check your calendar, and offer a reply suggestion that includes flight data. The suggestion is shown on the screen, letting you reply to the message with just one tap.
The feature will eventually land on all Android devices, but for the moment, it remains exclusive to the Google Pixel. No further specifics have been shared on its expansion.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution Android Auto 18.2 could include more fixes for bugs that have been reported in the last few weeks, so if you’ve been struggling with broken functionality, updating could help. Otherwise, keep in mind that beta builds aren’t supposed to be used as daily drivers due to the increased likelihood of problems, so you’d better wait for the production rollout if stability and reliability are critical to your experience with Android Auto (such as for navigation).
Once the production rollout starts, the new Android Auto will be shipped to all devices as an automatic update through the Google Play Store.
The full build number of today’s update is Android Auto 18.2.1646 beta.

Parents Passed, So Their Dodge Dart Must Sell Because It's Just Sitting There
45 photos
Photo: eBay seller kasper$racing
Life sometimes gets in the way in the most painful ways, and this best describes the most recent years of this 1975 Dodge Dart . The owners passed in 2012, and the car has been left sitting in the same place ever since.
It now needs a complete restoration, and the seller decided to post it on eBay, trying to find someone willing to embark on this not necessarily challenging project.
The car is still complete, and it still has an engine, so bringing it back to the road shouldn’t be all that difficult. You won’t know this for sure until you see everything with your eyes, especially because the car has been sitting for over a decade.
Photo: eBay seller kasper$racing The 1975 Dodge Dart lineup included not one, not two, but nine different versions, beginning with the Dart Special, which could be had as a 2-door hardtop and a 4-door sedan. The Dart Swinger was available this year as a 2-door hardtop and Special 2-door hardtop, while the Dart Sport was offered as a 2-door coupe, the famous Sport Hang 10, and the 360 Sport 2-door coupe.
The Dart Special was the model that spearheaded Dodge’s 1975 push. “Uncommon luxury in a very practical size,” Dodge said about the Special Edition, explaining that this car combined the “traditional Dart economy and all the quality and luxury its name so richly implies.”
The Dart Special came with velour seats, a carpeted trunk, cut pile carpeting in the cabin, a full vinyl roof, a standard radio, power steering, and front disc brakes. You could fit the Special Edition with any engine in the lineup, beginning with the six.
The engine offering included only three choices.
Because most people got the Dart for economy, the 225 six was one of the most popular choices. It could be paired with a 3-speed manual or a TorqueFlite automatic.
The 318 allowed buyers to step into the V8 world, and this time, a 4-speed manual was also offered. The 360 was specifically aimed at the Dodge Dart Sport and could only be paired with the automatic transmission.
Dodge also offered a Rallye Package that was aimed only at the Sport. It included a 318 V8 engine, a 4-speed manual transmission, power steering, heavy-duty suspension, Rallye wheels and chrome trim rings, a special steering wheel, and a deluxe vinyl bench seat.
Photo: eBay seller kasper$racing This Dart is a Sport fitted with a six and an automatic. As anyone can figure out by simply checking out the photos in the gallery, the engine has seen better days, so its current condition is unknown. The seller explains that it still turns over, but they never tried to start it, meaning that you’ll be the one who must figure out if there’s still a chance to save it without spending high dollars.
The engine is still complete, and that’s the good news. Sure, a six isn’t necessarily the most desirable, so donating it to another project was very unlikely, but it’s a good thing because you can keep the car as close to the original configuration as possible.
The body needs work, and you can clearly see this in the photos shared on eBay. The more concerning part is the rot that has already reached the front frame rail, so my recommendation is to ask for more details specifically regarding these parts. A walkaround video would come in so handy, but if this doesn’t involve high costs, you should go there in person and check out everything with your own eyes.
There’s also rot in other places, but the floors are said to be in good shape.
The interior also looks good, though the headliner seems to require particular attention.
Photo: eBay seller kasper$racing This car has been sitting for over a decade, but there’s a chance that these recent years aren’t the ones responsible for all the problems that we can spot in the pics. I wouldn’t be surprised to learn that the Dart had been sitting for many more years prior to the 2012 sad event, and that’s why I believe that a live inspection would be more useful than anything else.
The car sells with a copy of an old registration and a title from 1986. A bill of sale from the son can also be included, the seller says.
As for the price, we have a committed seller here, as they posted the Dart on eBay without a reserve. The battle starts at $2,000, but the auction still has 0 bids at the time of writing. This doesn’t mean nobody wants the Dart, but many people might be waiting until the very last minutes of the auction to submit an offer in an attempt to avoid a fierce bidding war.
The car is parked in Attleboro, Massachusetts, and the auction ends in 2 days, so there’s little time left to decide if this Dart is worth your time and money.

Oddball News: Aston Martin x Star Wars, Bentley Motors and Paris Saint-Germain, Cupra Takes Up Padel
11 photos
Photo: Aston Martin
This week has been pretty quirky, if you ask us, even by 2026’s wacky standards, and we decided to bring together some of the crazier news that also involves members of the automotive industry to help you start the weekend with a smile.
We’re taking them in alphabetical order, but of course we would have started with this anyway. Aston Martin , that always-on-the-brink-of-disaster-and-bankruptcy ultra-luxury British sports car and SUV maker best known for its association with the James Bond movie franchise, has nailed another pop culture collaboration: they will celebrate together with Disney and Lucasfilm plus the entire planet and a galaxy far, far away 50 years of a major cultural icon.
Yep, you guessed correctly: Aston Martin is announcing a collaboration with Star Wars to join their 50th anniversary celebrations. It’s pretty random, of course, but Aston Martin and Star Wars , through the voice of the Gaydon, UK-based brand, say that these “two globally recognized marques (are) united by design, innovation and creativity,” and the automaker will mark the anniversary via year-long celebrations starting in January 2027.
Star Wars, “one of the most enduring cultural phenomena in cinematic history,” began in 1977 with the first theatrical release, now known during the modern era as Star Wars: A New Hope, aka Episode IV. When it launched, together with other movie phenomenon entries like Jaws, it “redefined modern storytelling and inspired generations of audiences around the world.” It’s impossible to say which one is larger than life, Aston Martin or Star Wars, but the companies have already decided what to do with their collabs.
“This unique collaboration will celebrate the artistry of British ultra-luxury craftsmanship and cinematic storytelling through a series of activations and collaborations across the anniversary year,” says the press release, and we already know that Lucasfilm has an extensive program to celebrate the legacy and future of Star Wars, with additional details about their plans with Aston Martin to be revealed in early 2027.
Secondly, Bentley has decided to forego the historic feud between Brits and the French by announcing an official partnership with the Paris Saint-Germain football club (soccer in the US) until 2028. So, Bentley is now their official motoring partner for the next two seasons, and together “they will explore new opportunities to engage their communities through exclusive experiences, curated moments and original storytelling inspired by the worlds of luxury, design, culture and sport.”
We bet that PSG’s stars will also get a new Bentley in the process, right? Last but not least, the Spanish premium sporty brand Cupra has found out that it’s passionate about padel, the new global phenomenon that combines elements of tennis and squash, and it recently became the Automotive Partner of the Emaar Dubai Premier Padel P1 tournament from 2026 to 2028.

EICMA 2026 • Triumph TF-E Bikes Get Even More Enduro With Updates for the 2027 Model Year
Sanrivatti One Is a New Old-School Modern-Day Hypercar With a Revolutionary Driving Position
27 photos
Photo: Sanrivatti
Car startups do not necessarily do well for themselves these days, but let’s not forget that names such as Koenigsegg and Pagani started like this. And now, we have another name that wants a piece of the exotic car pie: Sanrivatti .
You may remember some details about this company and its product from our previous stories from earlier this year. However, this time, we have much more than a sketch to work with. That’s because the startup just pulled the wraps off a concept that offers a clear look into its upcoming hypercar that will be known as the One.
It will be interesting to see whether they will stick to this name given that there is already a hypercar that wears this moniker, and it is none other than the Mercedes-AMG One . Guess that’s a question that will be answered in due course. Meanwhile, the Sanrivatti One is a real show car, and was just unveiled at the company’s headquarters in the Netherlands.
The Sanrivatti One Concept definitely looks exotic with its wedge-like silhouette, extremely fat wheel arches, a V-shaped nose, aggressive air intakes on the sides, and intricate-looking back end, and a massive wing. And everything is there for aerodynamic purposes. The small (future) automaker says that the design has been inspired by a peregrine falcon in a high-speed dive and a modern fighter jet.
Photo: Sanrivatti And that’s not all, because instead of featuring traditional doors and windows, the Sanrivatti One has a single-piece canopy. This component was obviously inspired by fighter jets, and it is integrated into the body. The jet-inspired intakes at the front channel the air passing through the car. A pair of slim headlights can also be seen, and the rear light graphics are said to “trace the body’s signature lines.”
While the exterior is definitely impressive, the interior is simply jaw-dropping. Do you remember Sanrivatti’s initial promise to revolutionize the driving position? Well, they have definitely kept their word. Thus, ladies and gents, meet the so-called Apex Position, which was inspired by motorcycles. And this is said to have revealed “an average of 3.2 times more visible racing surface than ten benchmark hypercars and track cars” that were assessed in virtual testing at Corner Three of Silverstone.
If you think that Sanrtivatti’s One is just another electric nonsense, or perhaps a hybridized one with forced induction being on deck, then you are wrong. That’s because the company went for a naturally aspirated engine. It is a 5.5-liter V10 mill from Judd Engines, which has a targeted 800 horsepower (789 hp/588 kW) at 9,000 rpm and 516 lb-ft (700 Nm) of torque.
Thus, while the company refers to the One as being a hypercar, it is actually a supercar. Or is it? Well, this is where the weight comes into focus, because the model has a targeted dry weight of only 1.1 metric tons. This equals 2,425 pounds. A six-speed sequential transmission from Hewland delivers the thrust to the rear axle, because the One is strictly rear-wheel drive. And the engine sits behind the passenger compartment, so the exotic layout is also there.
Photo: Sanrivatti The stopping power is provided by the 380 mm ventilated carbon brake discs from AP Racing with six-piston calipers at the front, and the 355 mm ventilated carbon discs with six-piston calipers at the rear. These back up the 18-inch forged magnesium alloys on both axles, which were shod in Michelin slicks, according to Sanrivatti. The one has double-wishbone pushrod suspension with independent heave and roll.
Sanrivatti’s One also boasts a carbon fiber monocoque architecture. It measures 112.2 inches (2,850 mm) between the axles, and is only 47.2 inches (1,200 mm) tall. The wheelbase is actually longer than that of the Lamborghini Temerario , but the height is pretty much the same. The brand states that its hypercar has a roughly 727 horsepower per tone power-to-weight ratio, and it can reach a top speed of 205 mph (330 kph).
Keep in mind that the output, thrust, performance, and other numbers are provisional, and they could change by the time the Sanrivatti One reaches production. But when will that happen? Your guess is as good as ours, because the One is merely a concept for now, and the next step requires building a functional prototype to test in the real world, on public roads and at the racetrack, but the company has already transitioned from philosophy to physical form.
Whether they will succeed with the prototype and then the actual production is a question that will be answered in due course. However, we reckon that they just might do that, and they could also be successful. After all, do you know another vehicle that a similar driving position? Here’s to seeing more of the Sanrivatti One in the near future, because this thing has the potential to challenge the likes of Lamborghini, Ferrari , McLaren, and other exotic automakers.

Jeep, Together With FOX Factory Vehicles and USO, Will Auction Customized Jeep Wrangler Commando 392
10 photos
Photo: Jeep
A bespoke Jeep Wrangler Commando 392 will be auctioned exclusively to the public through an online auto auction on Bring a Trailer between November 11-22, with the proceeds benefiting the USO – the United Service Organizations, the private, nonprofit-charitable corporation dedicated to members of the U.S. Armed Forces and their families founded by President Franklin D. Roosevelt in 1941.
Jeep has been extremely busy lately as it works its way back to the top of the roster for Stellantis’ North American operations after Ram Trucks recently dethroned it in quarterly sales. They just did a collab with Marvel Studios to promote both the brand and the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday blockbuster; SRT Performance joined the 2026 SEMA Show, featuring the first-ever Jeep Wrangler Scrambler concept truck; and they also updated many of their nameplates for the 2027MY.
Now, to honor Veterans Day, the Jeep brand, FOX Factory Vehicles, and the USO joined forces to auction a custom-built Jeep Wrangler Commando 392. This is the final Jeep Wrangler Commando unit, and it is the only public example out of the 250-unit limited series, with all the other “249 reserved for active-duty military personnel and veterans,” according to the Stellantis brand.
The exclusive Jeep Wrangler Commando prepared by Jeep , FOX Factory Vehicles and the USO went up for auction on Bring a Trailer on November 11, in time for Veterans Day, and bidding is open through November 22. The current bid stands at $100k at the time of writing, and that’s a good thing because there are another nine days to go, and we hope that it will establish a new record on BaT because all the proceeds will benefit the USO “and its mission to strengthen the well-being of service members and their families.”
This 2026 Jeep Wrangler Commando was created in collaboration with FOX Factory Vehicles and focuses on the Jeep brand’s military heritage, more precisely the legacy of the Jeepster Commando. Only 250 were produced, 249 reserved exclusively for active-duty military personnel and veterans – this is the only opportunity for someone outside the military to own a Jeep Wrangler Commando.
The special edition is based on the Wrangler 392 , featuring the Hemi 6.4-liter V8 engine, four doors, 470 hp and 470 lb-ft of torque, and an eight-speed automatic transmission. It can do zero to 60 mph in 4.5 seconds, along with a quarter-mile time of around 13 seconds. This example was displayed by Jeep at the 2026 SEMA Show and comes ready for off-road with Tru-Lok front and rear locking differentials, a Selec-Trac four-wheel-drive system, 17-inch beadlock-capable wheels, 37-inch Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, and more.
The modifications include the ’41 gloss Army Green paint with tube doors and a tan bimini top over tan and black leather upholstery, a Magnaflow exhaust system, a 3.5-inch JKS suspension lift kit, FOX 3.0 internal bypass shocks with remote reservoirs, a FOX ATS steering stabilizer, and an interior-mounted spare.
The SUV also has the Convenience Group, the Active Safety Group, the LED Headlamp and Fog Lamp Group, the Steel Bumper Group, the Technology Group, and the Trailer Tow Group, tow hooks, painted wheel arch extensions, a Warn winch, and a ton more.
Last but not least, SUV is also owned directly by Fiat Chrysler Automobiles and offered at no reserve with a clean Michigan title, plus “exclusive graphics, unique badging, custom wheels, and a specially designed interior with one-of-one colors and trim treatments, making it a true collector vehicle.”

The All-New 2027 Volkswagen Atlas Family Is Coming to the 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show For the Debut
9 photos
Photo: Volkswagen AG
This is the ensemble public introduction, of course, as the second iteration of the regular Atlas first appeared earlier this spring at the New York Auto Show in April, and the Atlas Cross Sport came out in August. Now, they’re holding hands and going to sunny California.
The German automaker Volkswagen hasn’t been very active in the United States lately, only announcing earlier this month that it is collaborating with NBCUniversal to “bring comedy legends together” in the NBC100 collab starring Tina Fey and Rachel Dratch, with the spot putting a “comedic spin on everyday life while showcasing the design and technology of the all-new 2027 Volkswagen Atlas and Atlas Cross Sport.”
On the other hand, there’s nothing to laugh about Volkswagen of America’s third-quarter US automotive market sales, which are down almost eleven percent from last year to just 78k units: just two units registered a positive result during the past three months – Tiguan was up more than 27%, and the venerable Jetta sedan was up by almost 25%. VW now hopes the all-new Atlas and Atlas Cross Sport will turn the tide – starting with 2027, most likely.
Right now, Volkswagen diligently prepares for its first outing together in front of the audience at the 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show . Both come with an all-new design inside and outside, “more upscale features,” and new technology like a new front center airbag and standard IQ.DRIVE driver assistance features.
Volkswagen of America will showcase the all-new 2027 Atlas family for the first time together, with the family-friendly 7-seater Atlas already on sale since October on the upgraded MQB Evo architecture, soft-touch surfaces and real wood décor inside, plus a large free-standing infotainment screen (15-inch) on all versions except the base one, which gets a 12.9-inch display. All versions have Volkswagen’s 10.25-inch Digital Cockpit Pro, a configurable gauge cluster.
Standard perks include a power liftgate, rear sunshades, a 9-speaker audio system, and a 14-speaker Harman Kardon premium audio system comes for the top trim. The Atlas Cross Sport , meanwhile, focuses on the five-seater midsize SUV segment, and it’s 6.5 inches shorter at 196.6 in overall compared to the Atlas 7-seater.
With a raked coupe-like rear and a short rear overhang, it is also 2.2 inches lower. Like the Atlas, it has been renewed inside and outside, and comes with a black headliner and available olive-green contrast stitching, gray wood décor, and more. Both have the Travel Assist feature, which enables semi-automated hands-on driving capability, and it’s now upgraded with driver-initiated lane changes.
The engine used in the Atlas and the Atlas Cross Sport is the latest evo5 EA888 turbocharged and direct-injection 2.0-liter four-cylinder TSI with 282 hp and 258 lb-ft of torque, which is now 13 hp more powerful than before. It’s combined with an eight-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic and standard FWD, while 4Motion all-wheel-drive is also available.
